headline: Delhi High Court restricts Bajaj Finance from using AI cameras to profile visitors, limiting use strictly to KYC
hook: Delhi HC halts AI visitor profiling
summary: The Delhi High Court has prohibited Bajaj Finance from using artificial intelligence cameras to profile visitors on its premises. The court ruled that the technology can only be used for mandatory Know Your Customer (KYC) verification processes. This decision impacts how the company collects and processes biometric data from customers walking into its branches. Indian retail investors should monitor this as regulatory and legal scrutiny over data privacy compliance could impact technology deployment costs and operational practices for financial institutions.
why_it_matters: Strict data privacy rules could limit tech deployment by lenders.
winners_losers: Privacy advocates gain / digital lenders hurt

headline: Gold prices drop 30%, stressing Indian gold loan lenders

hook: Mid and small caps outperform benchmark indices

This divergence suggests a rotation of interest toward mid and small-cap stocks despite the stagnation in large-cap benchmarks.
